answer: One plume circulates per epoch: each seat must sign it and pass it on. The karst ledger stamps every handoff with both parties' funding roots. A pass into a root not yet used resets the clock, while a second pass inside one root freezes the plume three hours, a third six, a fourth twelve, doubling each time. A lone holder signs once and moves on. A farm keeping k aliases inside one root stalls for 3(2^k - 1) hours, past any epoch close, so it must route the plume through k distinct outside holders, each pledging a sable bond forfeited if the plume misses reconciliation at the karst sinkhole.
